Stovner — Oslo, Norway

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Stovner is one of Oslo's 15 official bydeler (city boroughs). Oslo kommune's own police-sourced Statistikkbanken data recorded 2,231 reported offences with their place of occurrence here in 2024, across a population of 34,111 residents — a rate of 6,540 offences per 100,000 residents, roughly 0.7× the citywide average, below it. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central or nightlife/shopping-heavy bydel can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential bydel can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Oslo — real Oslo kommune Statistikkbanken figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Stovner safe?

Wandroz currently rates Stovner in Oslo, Norway as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Stovner safe at night?

At night, Stovner is rated as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Stovner a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Stovner's day rating (relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Stovner?

Not yet at neighbourhood level. Unlike London, this city does not currently publish an open, geolocated crime dataset at this level of detail (checked against the relevant local and national open-data portals — see the methodology page for what was checked).
